title: introduce-usage-weighted-profiles-and-autobrief-generator
author: Sofia Chen
description: Motivation: teams spend a lot of manual effort writing performance blurbs and choosing a baseline when onboarding model variants. This PR adds a small automation pipeline that 1) synthesizes performance profiles weighted by actual usage signals, 2) stamps model metadata with a delta-hash for versioned provenance, and 3) emits an "autobrief" release-justification snippet that the model registry UI and release tooling can surface to reviewers. Scope: a telemetry sampling worker, an API endpoint to request a profile dry-run, a CLI command for maintainers, a tiny template engine for autobriefs, and migration for the metadata.version and metadata.delta_hash fields. Privacy/opt-in: sampling respects the onboarded model's privacy flags and only pulls aggregated histogram metrics (no raw prompts). Key features included: usage-weighted bucketing by sequence_length and top-k cost bucket; sample-size heuristics to keep generation cheap; delta-hash calculation for metadata diffs; CLI dry-run "mr profile generate --dry-run" and API POST /profiles/generate that returns JSON-profile and autobrief text. Why now: reduces churn in changelog authoring and biases release notes toward what users actually hit in production. Backwards compatibility: existing metadata.version still works; new fields are optional and non-breaking. Rollout plan: feature-flagged for 2 weeks, small canary on private tenants, then enable globally. Checklist: [x] telemetry sampler worker; [x] delta-hash algorithm and tests; [x] CLI and API end-to-end; [x] autobrief template and i18n placeholder; [x] docs draft in docs/onboarding/autobrief.md; [x] add migration to mark existing profiles as legacy. Related: ENG-4512 ties this to the release automation epic, SUP-1283 surfaced a customer ask for rollouts guided by actual traffic.
commits: add telemetry sampler worker and sampling heuristics
implement delta-hash metadata util and unit tests
add CLI command mr profile generate with dry-run
add migration: add metadata.delta_hash and metadata.profile_source
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice direction. Please add a short section in the docs about privacy guarantees for sampling and how to opt-out. Also can we avoid sampling traffic from production tenants with 'suppress-probes' label?
Sofia Chen: Added opt-out and suppress-probes filter in the sampler config; updated docs to call this out and wired feature-flag to respect tenant flags.

Priya Nair: The delta-hash algorithm looks good. Suggest including a stable serialization step to ensure deterministic hashes across minor metadata reordering. Also add a test that ensures hash stability.
Sofia Chen: Added stable-serialize utility and unit tests; included test that simulates metadata field reorder and asserts same delta-hash.
Marcus Villanueva: Integration test failed once on the CI run due to timing of telemetry ingestion. Can we add retry/backoff in the integration harness?
Sofia Chen: Added exponential backoff and a fixture that seeds the telemetry store in CI; reran tests and they passed.
Priya Nair: Approving; please squash commits and include a concise release note.
Liam O'Connor: Approval after resolving outstanding docs nit.
release_notes: Add usage-weighted profile generation and autobrief release snippet. New metadata fields: metadata.delta_hash and metadata.profile_source. CLI: mr profile generate --dry-run. Feature-flagged rollout. Improves release note consistency by surfacing why a variant was promoted based on real usage.
